Subject: Request: POC runway extension & additional evaluation credits

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at Acme.ai is excited about the latency and cost profile we saw with Redwood. We're running into a procurement delay on our side that will push the formal purchase order out by ~6 weeks.

We started a 30-day POC with the default PLG credit bucket, but given the procurement timeline and the internal stakeholders who still need to evaluate, can Redwood extend the POC window by 45 days and grant an additional evaluation credit pool equivalent to roughly $12k (we estimate ~150M tokens at our current test mix)?

This extension is critical for us to complete the integration work and an exec review scheduled for mid-February. Happy to sign an amendment or a short MOU to formalize the extension. Procurement is copied on this note.

Appreciate any flexibility — this is a likely mid-market deal with expansion potential across three product lines.

Thanks,
Jennifer
